# Appointly Solutions

> Appointly Solutions books floor coating estimates for contractors. We run Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads in the contractor's service area, contact every homeowner lead within minutes, qualify them, and book the estimate directly onto the contractor's calendar. We work with one floor coating contractor per market. Founded by brothers Patrick and Jacob Mietka in Chicago, IL. Serving the US and Canada.

Who it is for: garage floor coating, epoxy, polyaspartic, and concrete coating contractors who want booked estimates instead of raw leads. Small and mid-sized markets are a specialty.

What we deliver: exclusive, booked, confirmed estimate appointments with homeowners in the contractor's service area. Not shared leads, not form fills.
